items.text: --> CFO Advisory Services | SMG ABA --> About
Strategic CFO Guidance That Drives Growth and Profitability
Gain the financial clarity, forecasting, and executive guidance you need to make smarter business decisions, improve profitability, and confidently grow your business.
Align your financial strategy with your business goals.
Develop realistic budgets and forecasts for smarter planning.
Improve cash flow visibility and maintain healthy operations.
Track meaningful metrics that drive informed decisions.
Identify opportunities to increase margins and improve efficiency.
Receive strategic financial guidance to scale with confidence.
Are You Making Business Decisions Without Financial Clarity?
Making important decisions without reliable financial data.
Struggling to plan ahead because cash flow is inconsistent.
Growing your business without a clear financial plan can increase risk.

Fractional CFO Services for Growing Businesses. Gain the forecasting, financial strategy, cash-flow visibility, and executive guidance needed to improve profitability and grow with confidence — without the cost of a full-time CFO.
Why SMG ABA? Executive-Level Insight. Tailored to Your Business.

As your business grows, financial decisions become more complex. Without strategic financial leadership, it's easy to lose visibility into cash flow, profitability, and future opportunities. At SMG ABA, we do more than deliver financial reports. We provide responsive, proactive guidance backed by integrity, accuracy, and accountability. Our CFO Advisory services give you executive level insights and forward looking strategies so you can make confident decisions, improve performance, and grow your business with clarity.
Top-tier financial leadership without the full-time investment.
Real-time reporting and analysis that drive better business decisions.
We work alongside you as a true partner in your success.
Is this right for your business?
Our CFO services are designed for businesses experiencing any of the following:
Have growing revenue but inconsistent profitability.
Need forecasts or better cash-flow visibility.
Have reliable bookkeeping but need executive-level financial guidance.
Preparing for expansion, financing, or acquisition.
Not Ready to hire a full-time CFO.
Want strategic guidance to achieve long-term goals.
Providing trusted accounting, bookkeeping, tax, and advisory services.
Helping growing businesses build stronger financial foundations.
Delivering proactive guidance backed by technical expertise and real-world business insight.
Supporting businesses across New York, Florida, and beyond.
Hospitality, professional services, contractors, real estate, and other growing industries.
Proficient in leading accounting and financial management platforms.
Helped a growing business improve cash flow forecasting, implement executive-level financial reporting, and support expansion planning with greater confidence.
Your financial statements should answer questions—not create them.

It is not often in life that find individuals, and an organization, which make you feel like you are part of their family. As far as Accounting Firms go, SMG fits the bill! Personally, I have been using Wes for my taxes since the early 2000's. As the SMG team continues to grow their team, the level of service and support I became accustomed to receiving continues to grow even stronger. My Insurance Brokerage also uses SMG on a professional level, and this is where their entire team truly shines. Each partner is always accessible, and prepared to explain various tax situations in as much detail as you can consume; no ask is too big or too small. I confidently refer SMG for all personal and professional relationships!

Greg is extremely helpful, Full of energy and always willing to go above and beyond to help me in the entirety of my business. His knowledge of tax laws saved me thousands and his expertise in Quickbooks got my small business operating super efficiently! Highly recommended!

I have been working with Wesley for 5 or 6 years now. While I have always been satisfied with the firm’s counsel and support, I will forever be grateful to the team for its assistance in navigating the last year and a half - no doubt the most challenging of our business’ existence.

The team at SMG is fantastic! We've had nothing but great experiences with their entire staff. I don't know what we would do without them. They're far more to us than just the folks who do our taxes. Our primary advisor, David, is basically family at this point in the way he expresses care for us and our company. They are hands on in our business and have provided a level of expertise, knowledge, and advice that has really helped us improve our company’s performance.

I highly recommend Greg and his entire team at SMG. They have been our accountants for 6 years, providing professional, yet personal management and advice for our business, while focusing. on our financial goals and responsibilities. They are trustworthy & knowledgeable , recognizing the importance of maintaining and growing our business . They are always available without hesitation, for consultation on any issues we might have.
